test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Alarmel Valli was associated with which of the following dances?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatanatyam**

 
 
• Originated in Tamil Nadu, South India.
 
• One of the oldest classical dance forms, with roots in the Natya Shastra.
 
• Characterized by precise movements, expressive gestures (abhinaya), and rhythmic footwork.
 
• Alarmel Valli is a globally acclaimed Bharatanatyam dancer, trained in the Pandanallur style.
 
• She is celebrated for her innovative interpretations while preserving traditional techniques.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi**

 
 
• Originated in Odisha, eastern India.
 
• Known for fluid movements, sculpturesque poses, and intricate footwork.
 
• Themes often revolve around Hindu mythology, particularly stories of Lord Jagannath.
 
• Prominent exponents include Kelucharan Mohapatra and Sonal Mansingh.
 
• Alarmel Valli is not linked to Odissi; her expertise lies in a different classical dance form.
 
 
 
• **Kathak**
 
 
• Originated in North India, with influences from Persian and Mughal cultures.
 
• Emphasizes storytelling, fast footwork, spins (chakkars), and rhythmic patterns (tatkar).
 
• Often includes Persian poetry and Hindu mythological narratives.
 
• Notable figures include Birju Maharaj and Sitara Devi.
 
• Alarmel Valli’s repertoire does not align with Kathak’s stylistic elements or heritage.
 
 
 
• **Manipuri**
 
 
• Originated in Manipur, Northeast India.
 
• Known for gentle, flowing movements and themes centered on Radha-Krishna (Raas Leela).
 
• Incorporates traditional costumes, drums, and cymbals.
 
• Key exponents include Guru Bipin Singh and Priti Patel.
 
• Alarmel Valli’s dance style is distinct from Manipuri’s lyrical and devotional emphasis.
